offering_description.value: Develops and sells software for building, deploying and managing business applications, data platforms and IT infrastructure. Customers are mainly enterprises and software teams, served through term and cloud subscriptions, licenses and support, with products delivered as on-premises software and hosted services.

primary_products.value: application development tools; data integration and connectivity software; database and data platform software; file sharing and secure transfer software; network and infrastructure monitoring software

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises and software development teams, including IT, finance and operations departments

end_markets.value: software; financial services; healthcare; manufacturing; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: cloud and term subscriptions to software and hosted services; product sales: perpetual software licenses sold to businesses; service fees: technical support, consulting and training

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells software and cloud platforms to businesses that run them in their own IT environments

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and other regions through offices and partners

specialization.value: related lines: application development, data platforms, file transfer and infrastructure monitoring lines sold to overlapping IT customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: channel partners, resellers and system integrators; online: online sales and cloud marketplaces for software subscriptions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules such as GDPR and CCPA apply to hosted data services
